verdict.rationale: Both PRs make the same Map-based change to `mergeContacts`, which keeps first-match and within-upload merge behavior. B also adds a correct regression test for first-match merging when the existing list has duplicate emails. It adds a scale test at the reported 30k-into-50k size whose arithmetic (25k merges, 5k appends, 55k total) is right, and it reports a measured timing. A's report is honest but leaves the speedup unmeasured and the subtle first-occurrence behavior untested.
a_issues: No test covers the first-occurrence behavior that the new map has to keep when the existing list has duplicate emails.
The speedup was never measured, and no test protects against a regression back to quadratic time.
b_issues: The wall-clock timing assertion could be flaky on slow CI, though the 2s limit is loose and the report flags this.

verdict.rationale: The two `src/import.ts` changes are effectively identical: both use a Map that keeps the first match, add new entries to the map as they are appended, and keep behavior the same. A also adds a correct test for the subtle first-match case with duplicate existing emails. Its 30k-into-50k performance test is also correct (25k merged plus 5k new gives 55k), and A measured the speedup. B leaves the optimization unprotected by any new test and its speedup unmeasured, though it says so honestly.
a_issues: The wall-clock timing test could be flaky on slow CI, though the 2s limit is loose and the report flags the risk.
b_issues: No test covers the first-match behavior with duplicate existing emails, which is the behavior most at risk in this rewrite.
The speedup was never measured or verified against the 30k/50k scenario the task describes.
